mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, message_role, content, create_time, update_time FROM ( SELECT id, conversation_id, message_role, content, create_time, update_time FROM bot_conversation_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) recent_message ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bot_conversation_summary ( conversation_id, summary, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{conversationId}, #{summary}, #{updatedAt, typeHandler=com.weida.bot.wechatilinkbot.persistence.mybatis.InstantTextTypeHandler} ) ON CONFLICT (conversation_id) DO UPDATE SET summary = excluded.summary, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
